text.card: A red giant 3,896 parsecs away, 24 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.93 solar masses and 24.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,358 K at its surface.
